value.rationale: Cyclic two-layer networks require both edge classes, so the investment problem has no edge-deletion phase. The theorem identifies the nontrivial fractional-power vanishing of optimal interlayer investment, the sharp cost-dependent constant, an exact finite-size optimizer equation, and a next-order network-coherence cost term. This supplies a concrete design law not available from unit-weight resistance tables.
